# Obsidian Windows 98 Edition

Obsidian Windows 98 Edition recreates the Windows 98 desktop inside Obsidian: classic window frames, title bars, buttons, menus and pixelated system fonts. It restores the period color palette, tabbed dialogs and vintage UI components.

![Obsidian Windows 98 Edition screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smusamashah/Obsidian-Win98-Edition/HEAD/screenshots/main.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Obsidian Windows 98 Edition"
    author: "smusamashah"
    repo:   "smusamashah/Obsidian-Win98-Edition"
    slug:   "obsidian-windows-98-edition"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/obsidian-windows-98-edition"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/smusamashah/Obsidian-Win98-Edition"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smusamashah/Obsidian-Win98-Edition/HEAD/screenshots/main.png"

    modes:  ["dark", "light"]
    legacy: true
    about:  "Apply a Windows 98 visual makeover to Obsidian, recreating classic window frames, title bars, buttons, menus, and pixelated system fonts. Bring back the retro color palette, tabbed dialogs, and vintage UI components for a nostalgic desktop feel."
}
```
